summary.zh: 吃了什么记在自己的服务器上：按建议一键记、对话里说、拍一餐或拍营养标签。营养先查你的食物库，再查 Open Food Facts、英国 CoFID、USDA，查不到的标「估算」。
summary.en: What you eat is logged on your own server: one tap from a meal plan, in chat, or from a photo of the meal or its nutrition label. Nutrition comes from your food library first, then Open Food Facts, the UK's CoFID and USDA; anything not found is marked as an estimate.

message.zh: 这是我刚吃的这一餐，记下来
message.en: Here's what I just ate. Log it.

message.zh: 这是包装上的营养标签，存进食物库
message.en: Here's a nutrition label. Add it to the food library.
